question: Who lost the 2021 NBA Finals? Show a table.

message.content:
The 2021 NBA Finals were between the Milwaukee Bucks and the Phoenix Suns. The Milwaukee Bucks won the series 4-2. Here is a table showing the series results:

| Game # | Home Team | Away Team | Score |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Phoenix Suns | Milwaukee Bucks | 118-100 (PHX) |
| 2 | Phoenix Suns | Milwaukee Bucks | 120-100 (PHX) |
| 3 | Milwaukee Bucks | Phoenix Suns | 120-100 (MIL) |
| 4 | Milwaukee Bucks | Phoenix Suns | 109-103 (MIL) |
| 5 | Phoenix Suns | Milwaukee Bucks | 119-123 (MIL) |
| 6 | Milwaukee Bucks | Phoenix Suns | 105-98 (MIL) |

The Phoenix Suns lost the 2021 NBA Finals.
